rationale.consistency: Idiomatic use of standard library maps and slices packages; perfectly matches Go and Caddy conventions.
rationale.edge_cases: Successfully handles parsing failures without leaking partial mutations and correctly isolates the options map.
rationale.scope: Strictly adheres to the constraints; introduces only the necessary parameter passing and state isolation.
rationale.readability: Cleanly structured with excellent, insightful comments explaining why state is being cloned and isolated.
rationale.robustness: Safely supports concurrent adaptations by eliminating shared mutable arrays and shallow-copying maps.
